items.title: Scalars aur vectors ka bunyadi tasawwur (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the unnumbered opening section (PDF 23).

blocks.text: Scalars aur vectors physics ke bunyadi tasawwurat hain. Physics ke bohat se masail mein sahih riyazi aur tasawwurati tareeqa lagane ke liye scalar aur vector miqdaron mein farq karna zaroori hota hai. Scalars aur vectors samajhna hamein yeh samajhne mein madad deta hai ke physics asal duniya ke halaat par kaise lagu hoti hai, jaise tay kiya gaya kul faasla nikalna (scalar) ya kisi force ki miqdar (magnitude) aur simt (direction) tay karna (vector). Yeh tasawwurat seekhna tanqeedi soch aur masail hal karne ki salahiyat barhata hai.

Yeh chapter bunyadi taur par vector algebra aur seedhi lakeer mein yaksan taur par tez hoti harkat (uniformly accelerated motion), yaksan gravitational field mein azadana girte ajsam ki harkat, projectile motion, aur ek aur do dimensions mein ajsam ke darmiyan tasurat se mutalliq hai.

blocks.caption: Chapter kya dhakta hai
rows: scalars, vectors, components, scalar aur vector products (2.1 se 2.3)
equations of motion, gravity ke tahat harkat (2.4, 2.5)
momentum, impulse, elastic aur inelastic collisions, rocket propulsion (2.7 se 2.12)

blocks.prompt: Physics ko ek ke bajaye do qism ki miqdarein kyun chahiye?
blocks.explanation: Kuch miqdarein unit ke saath ek adad se poori bayan ho jati hain, jaise chala hua faasla; doosron ko simt bhi chahiye, jaise darwaze par force, aur unhen jama ya zarb karte waqt us simt ka khayal rakhna parta hai. Scalars aur vectors ko alag rakhna batata hai ke kaun si riyazi lagani hai.

items: Scalars aur vectors ko mukhtalif riyazi chahiye; yeh chapter vector algebra, seedhi lakeer mein yaksan acceleration, free fall, projectiles aur ek aur do dimensions mein collisions dhakta hai.
